note: award_year and award_amount are null for every recipient: the published page does not state a year or dollar amount for anyone. school/program/standing are transcribed only where the bio states them.

recipients.name: Sophia Hamre
recipients.bio:
Sophia Hamre will be a senior at Grand Canyon University next fall, with plans to graduate in Spring 2027. The Leo Foundation has been such a blessing in my life, helping to ease the financial burden of tuition and allowing me to stay focused on my academic and professional goals. Their generosity has made a meaningful impact on my college experience, and I am incredibly grateful for their support. I look forward to carrying forward the impact of their investment in my future. Receiving the LEO Foundation scholarship is a transformative gift. Raised in a home centered on faith, Sophia has always valued learning and spiritual growth. allowing her to continue her studies with a sense of relief and determination. This scholarship empowers her to focus on her academic journey while deepening her faith and personal growth. She is excited to contribute to the community and support others who may be facing their own challenges. 

The generous support of the Leo Foundation, Madeline Winney, CEO and the Board of Directors has alleviated financial burden, but also reminds her that she is surrounded by people who believe in her abilities and her future. With this scholarship, she is inspired to move forward with confidence, perseverance, and a heart full of faith.

recipients.name: Sydney Hamre
recipients.bio: My name is Sydney Hamre, and I am currently a junior at Grand Canyon University. I am incredibly grateful for the opportunity to receive this scholarship, as it greatly supports both my academic journey and financial needs. This support allows me to focus more on my studies and continue working toward my goal of becoming an occupational therapist without the added stress of financial burden. I truly appreciate this investment in my future, and it motivates me to work hard and make the most of my education.

recipients.name: Elijah
recipients.bio: For Elijah, receiving a scholarship from the Leo Foundation is an incredible blessing that fills him with gratitude and purpose. It is a powerful reminder of the belief others have in his ability to graduate with a Sports Management Degree. Raised in a family grounded in faith, Elijah values both education and spiritual growth. His time working directly with Ms. Winney has deepened his faith, shaping him into a more confident and intentional individual. This scholarship enables him to focus on his studies, spiritual journey, and personal growth. Elijah is also serving as a Resident Assistant on campus, where he encourages and supports his peers. The generosity of the Leo Foundation and Ms. Madeline Winney lightens his financial burden, allowing him to embrace his calling and reminding him that he is part of a community that values education, faith, and perseverance!

recipients.name: Matthew
recipients.standing: Assistant Director, Hume Lake Christian Camp
recipients.bio: Matthew became a Christian at 18 years old despite his upbringing in a religiously unaffiliated home. Since that time, he has pursued pastoral ministry whole-heartedly. He has served at Christian youth camps and is currently working on his bachelor’s degree in Christian studies. This summer, Matthew will lead and serve youth as the Assistant Director at Hume Lake Christian Camp. “Without the help from LEO Foundation, I wouldn’t be here and wouldn’t have the opportunity to pursue my dream.”

recipients.name: Jacob
recipients.program: Biology, pre-medicine emphasis; now MBS master’s program
recipients.scholarship: BHHS Legacy Nursing & Health Related Scholarship
recipients.bio:
I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the LEO Foundation for awarding me the BHHS Legacy Nursing and Health-Related Scholarship. This generous support has been instrumental in allowing me to complete my bachelor’s degree in biology with an emphasis in pre-medicine. 

With this academic foundation, I am now enrolled in an MBS master’s program, which serves as a direct pathway to medical school. This opportunity would not have been possible without the kindness and generosity of the LEO Foundation. Thank you for helping me pursue my dreams.

recipients.name: Natalie
recipients.bio: Thanks to the LEO Foundation Scholarship, Natalie graduated with honors from an accelerated Bachelor of Science in Nursing program. She knew from an early age that this profession was her calling. The academic and book scholarship award allowed her to focus on schoolwork and studying. Natalie is now a registered nurse at an outpatient surgery center, helping dialysis patients. She is a registered nurse employed at Phoenix Children’s Hospital.

recipients.name: Isabelle
recipients.school: Grand Canyon University (transferred from UC Santa Cruz)
recipients.program: MBA in Finance; BS Business Management, minor Finance
recipients.standing: Master’s student; Assistant Director of Corporate Affairs
recipients.bio: I am currently a Master’s student at Grand Canyon University studying to receive my MBA in Finance. The LEO Foundation has supported me with scholarships for my Master’s degree program. My studies started at the University of California, Santa Cruz, before transferring and graduating from GCU with a Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management and a minor in Finance. I played NCAA Women’s Tennis at both UCSC and GCU. I currently hold a position as Assistant Director of Corporate Affairs for a Phoenix company, where I manage Operations, HR, Marketing, and Payroll.

recipients.name: Eunice
recipients.bio: Thanks to LEO Foundation Scholarships, Eunice graduated in 2021 as an electrical engineer. She is thriving on the east coast with her dream job at Google. Her six-year journey, which started when she was a 15-year-old girl living on another continent, had many twists and turns, but her faith, patience, and strength always prevailed.

recipients.name: Sebastian
recipients.program: Business Administration/Management; Master of Management, Communications and IT
recipients.bio: Sebastian began his collegiate career with a soccer scholarship until an injury forced him to retire his jersey. With new scholarship funding from LEO Foundation, he was able to continue school and graduate with a degree in Business Administration/Management and obtain a Master of Management, Communications, and IT. Sebastian now owns a business providing IT project management support and solutions.

recipients.name: Joshua
recipients.standing: Second year; entering Phoenix Seminary Aug 2024 for M.Div.
recipients.bio: Through the support of the LEO Foundation and dedication to his goal, Joshua is in his second year of an accelerated three-year undergraduate program to become a pastor in Christian ministry. He realized his calling from God during his junior year of high school and continues to pursue God’s plan for his life. Joshua’s journey has included ministering to youth in the community through his church and summer camps. After graduation, Joshua will pursue a Master of Divinity with plans for a life of ministry as a teaching pastor and serving in various capacities for which he is called and equipped. “I am incredibly thankful for the scholarship funding from the LEO Foundation. It makes all of this possible. After finishing my undergraduate degree at GCU, I will now be attending classes August 2024 pursuing a Masters of Divinity in Theological and Biblical Studies at Phoenix Seminary.”

recipients.name: Jaiden
recipients.bio: Basketball is more than a game; it’s my structure, my community. I’ve been playing since I was five years old. As a kid, I moved schools a lot. Moving was never easy, especially because I have a learning disability and hearing difficulties. The court became my safe place, and my teammates developed into a sisterhood. I’m grateful and excited to have the opportunity to study business management at Yavapai College. Playing basketball made this possible. The game’s fast-paced environment helped me with my problem-solving, creativity, and self-confidence. It also helped me get out of my social shell and have the courage to express myself.

recipients.name: Keian
recipients.bio: I am Keian and a freshman at GCU. After graduating from high school, I had a great opportunity to go on a humanitarian trip to Guatemala. It was one of the best experiences of my life! My father served his LDS mission in Guatemala, and ever since I was born, he has wanted to take me there and show me all the places he lived during his two-year mission. The trip was a life-changer. I spent two weeks serving others by building houses, laying and mixing cement, visiting families and giving them clothes and food, and helping little kids at a school in the areas we served. My favorite part of this entire trip was being able to visit families experiencing poverty and giving them food and clothes, which put the biggest smiles on their faces. I wanted to thank the LEO Foundation for the scholarship. Paying for school was one of my biggest fears and one thing holding me back from going. So thank you, thank you, THANK YOU!

recipients.name: Caleb
recipients.program: Entrepreneurial Studies and Digital Production (screenwriting emphasis) — double major
recipients.bio: I am a Senior at Grand Canyon University, double majoring in entrepreneurial studies and digital production with an emphasis on screenwriting. Two polar opposites, right? I’d tend to agree, but as I enter my senior year, I am amazed at how much of a role each major has played in the success of the other. The organizational skills learned in my business classes have proven to be essential as the very nature of film is teamwork. Likewise, my creativity has tremendously supported my pursuit of a business degree. The LEO Foundation has helped me in every step of my college career and has given me the opportunity to finish my Bachelor’s program on a high note. The LEO Foundation CEO, Madeline Winney, said, “God’s gift to you is who you are, and your gift to God is what you do with it.” With encouragement like this, one can not help but feel reassured that they are on the right path. The support of the LEO Foundation has allowed me to receive an education that not only has played a critical factor in who I am today but has given me the skills and knowledge I will use to help build a better tomorrow.

recipients.name: Brooklyn
recipients.bio: I am so grateful for the LEO Foundation and everything you do to make things like a college education possible. With support from the LEO Foundation, I can study Biology with the intent of going to medical school after obtaining my bachelor’s degree. Scholarship opportunities like this give other students and me time to focus on studies and get involved on campus. I am incredibly thankful for the funding that has made this foundation possible, giving students more opportunities to achieve their dreams.

recipients.name: Julian
recipients.bio: Through my scholarship opportunity, I have met some amazing people and have found my path in life and a new relationship with God. The Leo Foundation Scholarship Award has given me, a first-generation Hispanic higher-education student, the opportunity to accomplish my goals of getting a Business IT degree, making a name for myself in this precious life, and making my family proud. This opportunity has changed my life!
